Reggie Miller Looks GoodWeek 4Nov 9 – Nov 15, 2026

You Had Me At Herro Stays Perfect, Wemby Swats Everything

The season so far

Four Weeks In, One Team Still Spotless

You Had Me At Herro is 4-0 and sitting on a 27-9-0 category record. Nobody else is close. Doublemint Jump climbed a spot to second at 22-14-0, and A Nice Keyonte moved up to fourth. CanAsian Mamba and Avengers Doomshai each slid one rung after losses. It is early. Four weeks are done on a 13-week schedule. Naturally, in this league, that means it is time to panic.

The top 8 make the playoffs, and the bracket is staggered, so seeding matters. Right now Blightsteel Ballers hold the last ticket at 17-19-0 after two straight wins. Toumani Turnovers jumped two spots to seventh. Having a Harden Time fell two spots to ninth at 15-20-1 and has dropped three in a row. Tyler's Tenacious Team, LaMelo Yello and A Wild Zubac Appeared! are also on the outside. LaMelo Yello has won two straight, though. A Wild Zubac Appeared! is 0-4, but there is a lot of basketball left.

Player of the week

Wembanyama Puts A Lid On It

Victor Wembanyama
Blightsteel Ballers · won 5-4 v Tyler's Tenacious Team · 4 games

Victor Wembanyama blocked 21 shots in 4 games. That is half of the 42 Blightsteel Ballers posted, in a BLK category they won 42 to 27. He also pulled down 42 REB, 21 percent of the team total in a 202 to 152 win on the glass. His .623 shooting lifted the team to a .501 FG% win. His 16 AST mattered too, since that category was decided by two. Add just 6 TO in a turnover win, plus 110 PTS and 8 threes for good measure. Blightsteel Ballers won 5-4 over Tyler's Tenacious Team, and his fingerprints are on all five.

Blightsteel Ballers edged Tyler's Tenacious Team 5-4, and it came down to a whisper. AST went 127 to 125. Flip that one and the whole matchup flips with it. Victor Wembanyama swatted 21 shots in a 42 to 27 BLK win, and Dylan Harper chipped in 22 AST with only 3 TO. Blightsteel also took FG%, REB and TO.

Tyler's Tenacious Team did plenty right. Darryn Peterson hit 13 threes and scored 92. Deni Avdija added 86 PTS in just 3 games. They won FT%, 3PM, PTS and STL, the last one 40 to 39. It was not quite enough. That is three straight losses for Tyler, and two straight wins for Blightsteel, who hold the eighth and final playoff spot. Panic levels: seasonal.

Streamer spotlight

Ziaire Williams Steals One For Tyler

Tyler's Tenacious Team added Ziaire Williams on November 9, and he paid off fast. In 3 games he had 6 STL, 10 AST and 27 PTS on .611 shooting, with a perfect 1.000 at the line and just 1 TO. The steals were the story. Tyler won STL over Blightsteel Ballers 40 to 39, a one-steal margin, and Williams had six of them. The matchup got away, 5-4, but the pickup did its job.
